mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 6 months signals an easing monetary policy, which reduces discount rates applied to equity valuations, thereby generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of FEDFUNDS decline, or the rate of decline slows below 0.5% monthly.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid decline in the unemployment rate below 8% in the next month signals labor market strengthening, prompting corporate investment and equity price appreciation, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 8.0 in the next month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative despite UNRATE crossing below 8.0, or the rate does not fall below 8.0 within the month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both GDP growth (GDPC1) and retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 2% in the same month indicates robust demand expansion, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and RSAFS increase by >2% in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive when both proxies rise >2%, or the increases are not concurrent.

mechanism_narrative: In a 'late-cycle expansion' regime, sustained FEDFUNDS rates below 2.0% for four consecutive weeks signals accommodative monetary policy, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 2.0% for 4 consecutive weeks in late-cycle expansion regime
failure_condition: 60-day returns are not significantly positive during the specified period, or FEDFUNDS does not stay below 2.0% for four weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in the industrial production index (INDPRO) by over 1% indicates growing supply-side momentum, which reduces production bottlenecks and supports corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are not significantly positive during periods of INDPRO growth, or the growth rate does not exceed 1% monthly.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 600 units in the next month signals robust demand in the housing sector, spurring construction investment and corporate activity, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST crosses 600 in the next month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative despite HOUST crossing 600, or the increase does not occur in the next month.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in employment (PAYEMS) and falling unemployment (UNRATE) by over 1% in the same month reflect labor market stabilization, boosting consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both PAYEMS and UNRATE increase by >1% in the same month
failure_condition: 60-day returns are not significantly positive when both proxies rise >1%, or the increases are not concurrent.

mechanism_narrative: In a 'post-shock recovery' regime, a 2% monthly increase in industrial production (INDPRO) outpacing the CPIAUCSL inflation rate for two consecutive months signals supply-side dominance, reducing inflationary pressures and supporting equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO growth > CPIAUCSL inflation for two consecutive months in post-shock recovery regime
failure_condition: 60-day returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO growth exceeds CPIAUCSL inflation by 2% over two months, or the regime conditions are not met.
